status: registered before any E2 training or evaluation
question: Can one projector-only EO reader (OlmoEarth v1 Base embeddings -> Olmo-3-7B-Instruct, frozen) be trained on two phenomena from two sensors (landslide / Sentinel-2, flood / Sentinel-1) so that on held-out regions and events it (a) answers from the embedding under the within-tile swap control and (b) beats a blind reader trained with the same budget?
prior: MS-156 (E0): the single-task landslide projector reads the embedding for Q1 (d_swap .203 [.135,.271]) but not for Q3 location.

data.landslide_train: /home/work/data/olmoearth/sentinel_qa_train_v0/items.jsonl, type Q1, tiles with an embedding (olmo_streaming_dev/single_fp16)
data.landslide_test: /home/work/data/olmoearth/sentinel_qa_v0_1/items.jsonl, type Q1 (holdout_hiroshima, holdout_indonesia; exposed in MS-131/MS-156)
data.flood_test: flood_qa_v0 fold test: 10 events disjoint from train (never used before)
data.flood_validation: not used (no model selection; fixed epochs)
data.embeddings: landslide: (12,768,32,32) per-date, avg-pool 4 -> 8x8; flood: (3,768,48,48) pre_1/pre_2/post, avg-pool 6 -> 8x8. Both: 64 tokens per date plus d2-d1 tokens (192 tokens)
data.prompt: These are 2 Sentinel-{2|1} observations of the same area in chronological order, taken on <d1>, <d2>: <EO> Did a {landslide|flood} occur between the two observations? Answer with yes or no.

arms.reader: projector (same architecture as MS-131) trained on the mixed train set, seeds 1, 2, 3
arms.blind: the same projector and budget with the EO input always zero (a learned soft prompt of the same length); seeds 1, 2, 3. This is the trained text-only baseline MS-131 lacked

training: 3 epochs, AdamW lr 1e-4 wd 0.01, batch 8, items shuffled across phenomena, no early stopping, no model selection

reader: real_all (all test items incl. flood hard negatives)
swap_cross_tile (same fold, same phenomenon, opposite answer)
evaluation.decoding: greedy, max_new_tokens 16, same parser as MS-131
per_phenomenon_metrics: d_real / d_swap / d_cross / d_zero with 95% tile bootstrap (2000)

primary_verdict.reads_both: for BOTH phenomena, in at least 2 of 3 seeds: d_swap >= 0.10 with CI lower > 0 AND reader balanced_acc - blind balanced_acc (same seed) >= 0.05
primary_verdict.reads_one: the reads_both condition holds for exactly one phenomenon
primary_verdict.invalid: parse failure > 10% in any evaluated arm of any seed, or a training run crashes (reported, not re-run with changed settings)

descriptive_only: flood hard-negative FPR vs within-tile negative FPR (a large gap would mean a 'post image' shortcut)
landslide balanced accuracy vs MS-131 single-task .607 (effect of mixing)
what_this_does_not_show: location/grounding (Q3 was not read in E0 and is not trained here)
that the reader identifies the phenomenon rather than any change between the two dates
generalisation beyond two phenomena, these sensors, or these event/region splits
compute: GPU1 only (CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=1); the run starts only after GPU1 has no other process and then holds it for all 6 trainings and evaluations in one process. A small probe (few items, 1 step) runs first in the same process to catch errors; probe outputs are discarded
